title: Shield-Frenzy
text: Alchemist, Cobalt, & Umbra are core to getting juicy Shields (capped at 96), giving a total of 196 HP before Forest.
Metal & Bee should cycle loot and get T3 ASAP, while also feeding Cobalt Diamond Armor + CB.
Alchemist gives Cobalt Leather Armor early game.
Alchemist crafts Heal & Shield Potions for the team and keeps Sleep & Poison Potions for themselves to protect the bed.
